brief: Holds a local SQLite database as the data port of the service plane: a real database in a file you own, not a fake.
detail: A data port is any object with Exec, Rows and Value, the surface stzDatabase already has. This source is local-real: SQLite is not a pretend database, so it may ship, and registering it with BindLocal says so. The one dangerous case is the :memory: path, a genuine database that loses every row at restart and is one character away from a file path, so IsEphemeral reports it and the registry treats it as an error in a production phase. The three port methods run the SQL text as written; the small conveniences, TableExists, Tables and RowCount, build their own SQL. At deploy a hosted client such as Postgres is bound behind the same three methods.
example: o1.Exec("CREATE TABLE people (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
? o1.Value("SELECT name FROM people WHERE id = 2")
